Statement I: The total number of matches in a single league tournament of 'N' teams is calculated by the formula: $N(N - 1) / 2$.
Statement II: In a single league tournament of 6 teams, the total number of matches played will be 15.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains a factual error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. Matches = $6(5)/2 = 15$.
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questionText:
Arrange the correct order of allocating byes in a knockout fixture according to standard rule:
(A) First bye is given to the last team of the lower half
(B) Second bye is given to the first team of the upper half
(C) Third bye is given to the first team of the lower half
(D) Fourth bye is given to the last team of the upper half

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Standard bye order: 1st to bottom of lower half, 2nd to top of upper half, 3rd to top of lower half, 4th to bottom of upper half.
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
